SMTO-PSM-0016 — SMTO couldn't draft the parameter automatically

GUID: 2aabae1c-022f-47fb-8f63-535b8aef4955
Slug: parameter-draft-unavailable
Domain: PSM · Subsystem: psm

What happened

  • SMTO tried to use an AI model to fill in a new parameter from your description, but no suitable model was available. Nothing was saved.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Parameter Store from the More options menu (⋯), select New, fill in Key and the value on the Value tab, then select Save. Creating it by hand doesn't need an AI model, so it works even when drafting isn't available.
  2. To pre-fill common fields, pick a template in the list next to New (it starts at Blank) before selecting New. Templates give you the right fields for things like server connections without needing the model.
  3. If you want automatic drafting back, ask the person who manages SMTO to check that Parameter drafting has a working model in Settings › Setup model routing. Drafting uses the model chosen for Parameter drafting, and none that supports it is available right now.

What success looks like

  • The new parameter appears in the Parameter Store list.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Parameter drafting received a model client without a callable complete_json method, so no AI-assisted parameter draft could be produced.

What this means

  • Parameter drafting finds no callable complete_json method on its supplied model client. Accepted parameter bindings preserve exact identity and revision. Validation does not authorize secret substitution, alias guessing or replay of earlier work; failed write confirmation requires reading the original stored state.

Why this can happen

  • Parameter drafting finds no callable complete_json method on its supplied model client.

How to diagnose it

  • Check client wiring and structured completion support; this local guard does not test endpoint health.

How to fix it

  • Check the model routing for the 'Parameter drafting' helper call type (parameter_draft in src/agent_runtime/model_routing.py) and ensure the runtime llm_client supports complete_json. draft_parameter_from_prompt normally falls back to heuristic drafting; otherwise create the entry directly in the Parameter Store editor.
  • Restore a compatible structured drafting client or enter the parameter directly through the supported editor.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • A compatible drafting client is available or the intended entry is created directly through its editor.

What not to do

  • Do not remove retained state or weaken trust checks to make an unavailable dependency appear healthy.

Technical notes

  • Accepted parameter bindings preserve exact identity and revision. Validation does not authorize secret substitution, alias guessing or replay of earlier work; failed write confirmation requires reading the original stored state.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
